function prepare({body,locationId}){const b=body??{},email=typeof b.email==='string'?b.email.trim():'',phone=typeof b.phone==='string'?b.phone.trim():'';if(!email&&!phone)throw Error('Contact email or phone is required');if(typeof b.address!=='string'||!b.address.trim())throw Error('A primary address is required');if(typeof locationId!=='string'||!locationId.trim()||locationId==='YOUR_LOCATION_ID')throw Error('Configure the HighLevel location ID');const city=typeof b.city==='string'&&b.city.trim()?b.city.trim():null,state=typeof b.state==='string'&&b.state.trim()?b.state.trim():null,zip=typeof b.zip_code==='string'&&b.zip_code.trim()?b.zip_code.trim():null;if(!zip&&!(city&&state))throw Error('Provide ZIP or both city and state');const secondary=typeof b.address2==='string'&&b.address2.trim()?b.address2.trim():null;return{primary:b.address.trim(),secondary,city,state,zip,contact:{locationId:locationId.trim(),...(email?{email}:{}),...(phone?{phone}:{})}}}

return {json:prepare({body:$json.body,locationId:'YOUR_LOCATION_ID'})};

function plan({verification,contact}){const d=verification?.deliverability,allowed=['deliverable','deliverable_unnecessary_unit','deliverable_incorrect_unit','deliverable_missing_unit','undeliverable'];if(!allowed.includes(d))throw Error('Lob did not return a recognized deliverability status');const tag=d==='deliverable'?'Mailing Address Deliverable':'Mailing Address NOT Deliverable';return{body:contact,tag,deliverability:d}}

return {json:plan({verification:$json,contact:$('Prepare address and contact').item.json.contact})};

function contact({response,statusCode,tag,deliverability}){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||typeof response?.contact?.id!=='string'||!response.contact.id)throw Error('HighLevel contact upsert was not confirmed; inspect before retrying');return{endpoint:'/contacts/'+encodeURIComponent(response.contact.id)+'/tags',body:{tags:[tag]},tag,deliverability,contactId:response.contact.id}}

return {json:contact({response:$json,statusCode:200,tag:$('Choose the deliverability tag').item.json.tag,deliverability:$('Choose the deliverability tag').item.json.deliverability})};

function confirm({response,statusCode,tag,deliverability,contactId}){if(statusCode<200||statusCode>=300||!Array.isArray(response?.tags)||!response.tags.includes(tag))throw Error('HighLevel tag was not confirmed; inspect the contact before retrying');return{result:{contactId,deliverability,tag}}}

return {json:confirm({response:$json,statusCode:200,tag:$('Confirm the contact').item.json.tag,deliverability:$('Confirm the contact').item.json.deliverability,contactId:$('Confirm the contact').item.json.contactId})};
